edu.instructions: Rate the educational value of this web page extract for teaching from primary school to grade-school level (FineWeb-Edu additive rubric). Judge the page text in `content`, not its title alone.
criteria: No educational value: ads, navigation, listings, spam, gossip or content with no information useful for learning.
Some basic information relevant to an educational topic, mixed with irrelevant or promotional content.
Touches educational elements but is superficial, disorganised or not aligned with school-level learning.
Appropriate for educational use; introduces key concepts coherently, like an introductory textbook section or basic tutorial, with limitations.
Highly relevant and beneficial for learning up to grade-school level; clear, focused, textbook-chapter or tutorial quality, may include exercises.
Outstanding educational value; detailed reasoning, easy to follow, thorough insight, no non-educational content.

page_type.instructions: What kind of web page is `content`?

criteria.tutorial_or_reference: Explains a topic, teaches a skill, or is reference material
criteria.commerce: Sells, lists or advertises products, services, deals, rentals or jobs
criteria.forum_or_social: Discussion threads, Q&A, comments or social posts
criteria.entertainment: Gossip, lyrics, sports results, games or gambling
criteria.boilerplate: Mostly navigation, login walls, cookie notices or error pages

boilerplate.instructions: Is most of `content` navigation, menus, cookie notices, ads or other boilerplate rather than page body?
